DEPARTMENT OF ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE LAB
NATIONAL INSTITUTE OF HIGHER STUDIES
Date: October 24, 2024

To the Graduate Admissions Committee,

I am writing to offer my enthusiastic recommendation for Aditya Rajendra Verma, who I have mentored as Thesis Advisor & Course Instructor during their study period (2021-2023) at National Institute of Higher Studies.

During this tenure, Aditya Rajendra Verma demonstrated exceptional mastery in Computer Vision, OpenCV, TensorFlow, Edge AI. In our research laboratory, they led the pivotal development of 'High-Throughput Microservice Architecture for Cloud Streaming', exhibiting remarkable technical intuition, rigorous experimental discipline, and intellectual maturity. Additionally, the candidate maintained an exemplary academic record with a GPA of 9.4 / 10.0.

Beyond technical competence, Aditya Rajendra Verma displays genuine leadership, integrity, and proactive collaboration. I rank Aditya Rajendra Verma among the top 1% of researchers I have supervised. I strongly recommend them for admission and financial fellowship without reservation.

Warm regards,

Dr. Rajeshwar Rao
Senior Research Director
Artificial Intelligence Lab
National Institute of Higher Studies
Email: .rajeshwar.rao@nationalin.edu
